item.title: House approves bill to eliminate registration decals
item.description: A proposal backed by Gov. Ron DeSantis to eliminate the requirement to place yellow vehicle registration stickers on license plates was approved by the House on Wednesday. The measure, HB 841, passed in a 93-17 vote. item.title: Department of Health moves to cull thousands from AIDS drug program
item.description: The Florida Department of Health issued emergency rules Wednesday that will block thousands of Floridians from accessing HIV medication. Beginning Sunday, the state will reduce subsidies for the AIDS Drug Assistance Program, limiting eligibility to people at or below 130% of the federal poverty level. Previously, the cutoff was 400%. item.title: Senate passes bill preparing for penny’s parting
item.description: Florida is preparing for the end of the penny. A bill, SB 1074, that would allow retailers to round cash transactions to the nearest nickel passed unanimously in the Senate on Thursday. item.description: The Washington County Sheriff’s Office (WCSO) hosted its first Lunch with the Sheriff Fish Fry on Saturday, February 28, at the Hinson Crossroads Fire Department in Caryville. item.title: Washington County de-claws FEMA clawback: County wins FEMA arbitration case
item.description: Washington County scored a major legal victory against the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), with an arbitration panel ruling in the county’s favor on February 27 after a long-standing funding dispute. FEMA notified the county in May 2024 that it would deny and de-obligate approximately $79.6 million for what the agency called ineligible hazard mitigation.
